notes.title: Update for “Legacy Edition” DLCs
notes.notes:
Update “Legacy Edition” DLCs with:
1. Files to run in Retro PCs DOS / DosBox (not included)
2. Better Linux distribution of ScummVM
3. New ScummVM with fix for missing subtitles in the Dungeon
4. New Hebrew Dub DLC
